title: Chats
summary: Conversations with the assistant are kept, synced, and can be opened beside any screen.
description: The assistant is a conversation that goes on: chats are kept and continued later, on any device, and the current one opens beside whatever the author is looking at.

stories.as: an author who thinks things through in conversation
stories.want: to come back to a chat later, on any device
stories.soThat: a line of thought isn't lost when I close the app

stories.as: an author reading a paper or writing a page
stories.want: to ask the assistant about it without leaving it
stories.soThat: the question comes while the thought is fresh

requirements.text: Conversations with the assistant are kept as chats, which the author can reopen, continue and delete.
A chat has its own address, `/chats/<chat id>`.
The assistant opens beside any screen, on the chat that was last open.
A turn keeps running when the author leaves the chat's screen, and a turn that failed can be retried.
While another device is answering a chat's last question, this device waits for that answer instead of answering it too, for at most `chat.answering-elsewhere`.
The tools the assistant used for an answer are shown with it, folded away.
An id of a page, block, library item, person or institution in an assistant message shows as a chip with its current title, which opens it.
An app address in an assistant message is a link that opens it in the app, such as a PDF at a page.

values.description: How long a question another device saved, unanswered, counts as being answered there.
